name: Red Ruby Aglaonema Variety (Chinese Evergreen)
description: Aglaonema 'Red Ruby' is a striking cultivar of Chinese Evergreen (Aglaonema) prized for its bold pink and red variegated foliage. It belongs to the Araceae family and features upright stems with broad, lance-shaped leaves displaying shades of pink, red, and green. The plant has an upright, bushy growth habit and thrives in warm, humid conditions with indirect light. Native to tropical and subtropical Asia, Chinese Evergreens are popular houseplants for their tolerance of low light and easy care. The Red Ruby variety adds vibrant color to terrariums, vivariums, and indoor plant collections. Like other Aglaonema, it is toxic if ingested.
careTips: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged
Bright indirect light; tolerates lower light
Toxic if ingested - keep away from pets and children
Avoid direct sun to prevent leaf burn
